summary: Generate and transform music or compose lyrics with Suno through RunAPI. Use when the user asks an agent to create, extend, transform music/audio, generate or blend lyrics, prepare voice validation phrases, or create reusable custom voices with Suno. Default to the RunAPI CLI for one-off generation; use SDKs only when the user is integrating RunAPI into an app or backend.
